storylines.title: Iran War
storylines.overview: The Iran War is a sustained international conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with military, maritime, economic and diplomatic consequences across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026, and security in the Strait of Hormuz has remained one of the conflict's central pressure points.
storylines.current_status: Estonia will close all its border crossings with Russia starting December 1, following a suspected sabotage attack on Threod Systems, a drone manufacturer. Authorities have linked the attack to Russia's GRU military intelligence service, claiming it is part of hybrid warfare. Eight individuals were arrested in connection with the incident, which involved an attempted arson at the facility.
